verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The added deterministic randomized differential compares bind_join as a multiset against an independently structured grouping-free nested-loop reference, exercises both the actual-sort and truthfully presorted no-sort branches, and covers empty inputs, duplicate rows, unmatched/NO_ID keys, varying distinctness, and multi-match fan-out. The three faulty-reference controls are required to fire and demonstrate detection of dropped duplicate rows, whole groups, and extra matches. The production run-grouping rewrite preserves every input-row/match pairing; stale sorted metadata can only split equal-key runs and cause redundant scans, not alter the output bag.
